decisions.change: Give both observed method paths equal prominence, label their actual reached draft states, and distinguish them from unverified submission and confirmation. Incorporate runtime discovery screens and flows without adding execution buttons.
Keep item instructions fixed, offer no jacket-return control, and expose only supported reason and method choices. Preserve the original-payment preference separately from source values.

Show a prominent conflict panel with full requested and observed destination labels, live task-derived deduction and refund, and Restore my choices. Do not treat a completed conflict review as a successful return or a verifier failure.
Restrict actions to explicit choice and check handlers, lock controls while working or after a receipt, expose errors and unknowns, and leave exact approval and verified completion to the host.
Explain that the initial read-only exploration blocked draft writes and did not verify all item and reason interactions.
Use a warm cream canvas, forest ink, readable type, visible labels, native controls, keyboard focus outlines, a live status region, and responsive single-column layout.
